elements.content: TEENAGE MUTANT NINJA TURTLES: MUTANT MAYHEM

Screenplay by

      Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg and Jeff Rowe,
             Dan Hernandez and Benji Samit


                        Story by

      Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg and Jeff Rowe,
                     Brendan O'Brien
A heavily armored VAN tears through the night at top speed.

Inside the van, T.C.R.I. (Techno-Cosmic Research Institute)
SOLDIERS armed with FUTURISTIC SWAT WEAPONS sit at anxious
attention, sweat glistening on their faces.

Their leader, SPIDER, a super-yoked military commando with a
Steven Segal ponytail locks and loads his rifle.

Listen up! We're going after Dr.
          Baxter Stockman. He was TCRI's lead
          genetic scientist, but he went
          rogue, stole billions of dollars
          worth of research and created an
          ACTUAL MUTANT. He's holed up in a
          makeshift lab of an abandoned
          building.

The SWAT guys look at each other nervously.

Each of you has been issued a high
          powered, anti-mutant-neutralizer.
          Whatever Stockman's made, this can
          unmake it.

Spider pats his rifle.

Cynthia Utrom herself will be
          quarterbacking from HQ. Anything to
          add Cynthia?

Spider gestures to a monitor with a live video feed to
CYNTHIA UTROM. Cold, menacing and German.

This mission is of the utmost
          importance. Failure will be...
          frowned upon. Bring me Stockman's
          mutant... and whatever he used to
          make it.

The SWAT guys look at each other: was that supposed to be
reassuring?
You heard her, boys, lock and load.

In the basement of an abandoned building, where exposed pipes
drip, drip, drip water down into fetid puddles, DR. BAXTER
STOCKMAN, a brilliant, disheveled scientist works feverishly.

He mixes various chemicals into a vial of GREEN MUTANT OOZE.

I've done it, Little One! I've
          perfected the ooze! Are you excited
          for Daddy?

We pan down to see that Stockman has an ANTHROPOMORPHIC FLY-
BABY. The Fly-Baby sits in an old pack `n' play, eating from
a cafeteria-size bag of Domino sugar and buzzing happily.

My "friends" at T.C.R.I. want to
          use you as a weapon! I couldn't
          allow that. But we're safe now.
          Soon, I'll make you brothers and
          sisters. A real family for both of
          us.

We see pictures of various mutant schematics - a warthog,
stingray, etc. There's little GREEN VIALS with newly-created
baby mutants floating in them.

I never had a family, little one...
          nobody liked me. I always felt a
          greater connection to the animals I
          experimented on than PEOPLE... So
          with you and your siblings... I'm
          creating a family... I think we can
          finally be happy...

Outside, there's a loud BANG! Stockman looks up, terrified.

Again!

The SWAT team slams a BATTERING RAM, breaking the door down.
The SWAT guys rush into the building.

We follow the SWAT team through the abandoned basement into
the lab, where they find Stockman frantically trying to pack
up his equipment. He holds the vial of ooze.

Freeze! Don't move! Where is the
          specimen?

I...I...uh...

The SWAT team finds the Fly-Baby's crib empty.

Wait wait be careful-

Spider covers his mouth.

(to Stockman) Stay quiet.

A shriek and then the SWAT guys start getting taken down one
by one by Fly-Baby.

Cease fire! We need them alive! (to
          Stockman) Don't move.

Fly-Baby lunges onto Spider's face and RIPS his eyeball from
its socket! He SCREAMS in agony and fires at Fly-Baby.

No! No! Don't shoot! The chemicals
          are highly volatile!

But it's too late. Spider shoots and the chemicals EXPLODE.

No!

Baxter leaps toward the Fly-Baby, shielding it with his body
but taking the FULL FORCE OF THE BLAST. Both Baxter and Fly-
Baby are ENVELOPED IN FLAMES.

When the flames clear, Baxter's fatally wounded body lies on
the floor, still gripping the VIAL OF OOZE.

The Fly-Baby is nowhere to be seen, seemingly INCINERATED.
Spider dusts himself off and looks at his fallen team. He
gets a call from UTROM.

Cynthia, I'm sorry. We lost
          everything.

A frustrated Cynthia sits in a giWhy they're gonna milk ant
room, surrounded by huge pieces of machinery and vats of
chemicals.

Bring me anything you can find. We
          will replicate his research, no
          matter how long it takes. Baxter
          Stockman's creations MUST live on!
          And with it a new form of life
          itself.

The SWAT guys grab what's left of Stockman's work. As they
remove his body, they don't see the dying Stockman release
his grip on the vial of ooze as he fades into the infinite.

The ooze ROLLS INTO A NEARBY SEWER GRATE, slipping into the
inky abyss, a wheel set in motion...

elements.content: TITLE CARD: TEENAGE MUTANT NINJA TURTLES - MUTANT MAYHEM

CHYRON: 15 Years Later



SEQ.0100 - Meet the Turtles

QUICK SHOTS of the turtles SUITING UP FOR BATTLE. Swords?
SHEATHED. Sais? GRIPPED. Bo? SPUN LIKE HELICOPTER.

The Turtles run out in formation, looking legit cool (perhaps
echoing the 80s opening). They sprint through a sewer pipe
overlooking the Brooklyn Bridge- they LEAP INTO THE NIGHT!

Leo stands before his brothers on a shadowy rooftop. He pulls
out an ANCIENT LOOKING SCROLL.

Master Splinter has given us a very
          important mission for tonight. The
          target is across the street. We
          must use stealth and cunning to
          infiltrate the human world and
          retrieve... Go-Gurt!!!

(making fun of his voice)          (mocking leo)
Go-gurt!!! We're going to the      Go-gurt!!! Why do you sound
bodega to get go-gurt!!!           like that?

Dude, what? I'm just trying to hype
          you guys up!

Raph grabs the list.

Gimme that list, what else we
          gettin?
              (reading)
          Four quarts of non-fat milk, ice
          cream, fruits and veggies...

-and a party-size bag of Cool Ranch
          Doritos.

He was VERY specific about party
          size. He underlined it twice!
Raph, you're stocking up the pantry-
- and Mikey, you're on junk food.

And remember, don't let any humans
see you! Because why???

Humans are the demon scum of the
earth, avoid them, don't say "hi."
They lust to murder that which is
different from them. To interact
with them, is to die.

And hey I know that's objectively
prejudice but that's what dad
taught us.

Uh, I think humans seem kinda cool
to be honest... Beyonce...

Drake! That guy's the goat of all
time!

We wouldn't have K-pop without
humans, so...

I would LOVE to have a champagne
brunch with Tom Brady-

Guy Fieri seems like a fun hang!
And I've always wanted to go to
Flavortown!

Look we all think humans are
cool...But we got a job to do.
    (deep voice)
Let's go.
You sound like you have bronchitis!

-Leo covers a security camera inside a bodega. Raph repels
down from the ceiling and grabs two loaves of bread. Donnie
grabs some toilet paper with his bo-staff.

-At the docks, Raph leaps onto a shipping container. He grabs
a jug of PROTEIN POWDER.

-Leo and Mikey LEAP onto a moving truck and break inside to
reveal bags of Party Size Doritos.

The Turtles ascend the side of a building that has a GIANT
screen on it. We see a NEWS REPORT playing on the screen...

Terror strikes the heart of
          Manhattan yet again today with
          another brazen and DEADLY heist! An
          industrial grade power converter
          was stolen mid-transport! Police
          fear it's connected with a recent
          string of other deadly thefts! New
          Yorkers live in fear! Parents
          citywide are calling for a curfew
          until the criminal is caught, but
          the only lead is a mysterious
          mastermind known on the streets
          as... Superfly.
Leonardo leaps onto a roof, followed by the others.

Not bad! Heading home on a good
          note. Let's get these groceries
          back-

Woah woah, what? We've only been
          out for an hour, come on let's stay
          out!

Guys come on we said we weren't
          gonna do this anymore! Last week
          was Madison Square Garden to watch
          the Knicks, the week before that
          was the Adele concert.
She hit them notes like crazy!
My spirit left my body.         It was transcendent!!

Splinter's gonna catch on, we're
          gonna get grounded.

He's a shut in. He doesn't know how
          long it takes to do things. For all
          he knows it takes three hours to
          get to the bodega.

No guys, we told him we wouldn't
          mess around anymore, alright?

(looking at his phone)
          Oh hey! There's an outdoor movie
          night in Brooklyn!
I hope it's a funny one!
Yeah!!! Hope it's violent!      You need to chill out, Raph.

Stop moping Leo, let's go!

The three brothers leap off the roof. Leo watches them, and
then reluctantly follows.

Ferris Bueller's Day Off plays on an outdoor screen. The
Turtles watch from a nearby roof. They are all entranced.
Oh wow that vest is a choice, huh?
I wish I had hair like that.
I wish I had hair, period!
We did go bald at a young age.

Is this high school like in real
          life?

Yeah, you go to high school you can
          just hijack a parade whenever you
          want.

Yeah I'm totally not jealous at
          all.

The turtles look DOWN AT THE CROWD of TEENS, hanging out...

A guy puts his arm around a girl. Leo clocks this, jealous.
Some jocks stand around downing beers.

Maybe one day everyone will love us
          like everyone loves Ferris Bueller.

Yeah, yeah you know, maybe one day.
          (clears his throat) Let's get home,
          guys.

They take one more look at the people having fun at the
screening before they descend into the sewer.

Guys, let's go.

They sneak past a group of TEENS on the subway platform.

I love being young and free to go
          places!

Mikey looks wistfully through a sewer grate out at the city.
The Turtles sneak back into their living room.

Dude that makes it louder...

CLICK! A LAMP turns on. SPLINTER is waiting.

Boys! Where have you been? I've
          been FREAKING out!

They all talk at once.

We're sorry Dad...                  There was this cat and you
                                    know I'm scared of cats...

There was a lot of traffic on the...
          sidewalk...

Wait a second... you said you would
          go shopping and come right back.
          Where were you?

The turtles stammer, searching for an excuse.

Look, we're really sorry, Splinter.
          Some of the guys wanted to see a
          movie, and I tried to talk them out
          of it.
What?! You WATCHED a movie?! With
Hey! DON'T use that word that way!

It wasn't that big a deal! We just
          watched a movie and came back.
          We're fine!

(grumble) You forgot, huh? You
          don't remember why humans are
          disgusting monsters? Why they're
          dangerous? Why they're gonna milk
          us for our blood?

They don't want to milk us      Again with the milking...
          dad.

You know what? I'm gonna tell the
          story again.

No!/Dad we hate the story!/It's
          such a bummer!/I get a year older
          every time!/Please please please
          no!/No no no!

Just for that, I tell you the LONG
          version. Hehehe!

elements.name: b
elements.content: EXT. NEW YORK CITY SIDEWALK - DAY - FLASHBACK
SPLINTER, a ragged NYC rat, rummages through trash.

It all start fifteen years ago. I
          was a young rat in my twenties.
          Look at me, I was so cute. I was on
          top of the world.
              (beat)
          No I was the BOTTOM of world! It
          was terrible! Nobody liked me, I
          had no friends! Raccoons didn't
          like me. Dogs did not like me. You
          know who hated me the most? Humans!
          I had one friend, he was a
          cockroach, we got along very well.
          His name was Kevin...
              (he's stepped on)
          And then, I ate him!

Splinter (the rat) climbs through the sewer grate...
... And finds the baby turtles covered in a mysterious ooze.

One day, everything changed.

One of them approaches and nuzzles up against Splinter.

You were the first things I met
          that didn't want to kill me or eat
          me. I could't just leave you there.
          You were covered in this ooze that
          someone had dumped in the sewers.
          Whatever this ooze was, it
          transformed us.

Splinter and the Turtles MORPH INTO MUTANTS.

Because I was older, I became older
          rat man. You guys were babies so
          you stayed baby turtle creatures.
          If you think about that, it
          couldn't make more sense.

The baby turtles run and climb around the sewer.

It was weird, but, we became a
          family.

SEQ.0310 - Weird Family

- They dance to a record.

- The baby turtles' stomachs rumble. They need food!

- Splinter feeds pizza to the baby turtles; they like it!

- Splinter mops up the sewer. The baby turtles draw on the
walls and each other, making a mess.

- Splinter bathes them and puts them to bed.

-After going to bed, the turtles crawl in with Splinter,
sprawled out on top of and beside him.

-While running through the sewer, the turtles notice colorful
lights from the surface. They motion to Splinter, wanting to
venture outside...

You were obsessed with the human
          world. So I decided to give it a
          shot.

Splinter and the turtles emerge in the heart of Times Square.
They take in the massive buildings and colorful
advertisements.

Woah!!!

People walk by, blissfully unaware of them.

Woww!!

Then... the humans notice Splinter, the rat man.
Oh my god it's a rat man!

A rat man?!/Everybody look at the
          rat man!

It's not a rat man, it's just a bad
          Mickey Mouse costume!
              (guy goes in for a selfie)
          It's real! I touched it! I touched
          it!

Mutant rat!/Kill the rat man!

HUMANS ATTACK SPLINTER throwing bottles and trash at him.

Splinter loses grip of the Turtles and everything goes SLO-
MO: They scatter in every direction, out of Splinter's reach.

Boys!! Mikey!

Splinter scoops up one, two, three turtles. He spots Mikey,
headed towards a bustling intersection.

Splinter charges through the crowd, shedding humans like a
wide receiver, catching Mikey just before he's hit by a
truck.

He cradles his babies, who smile up at him, oblivious.

That's not a cat, it's actually a
          rat! Get him before he goes back in
          the sewer!

Splinter disappears into a manhole, with turtles held close.

That day I promised to never let
          you get hurt EVER again. I needed
          to find a way to unlock ancient
          secrets of Ninjutsu. How to turn a
          body into a weapon of DEATH! And...
          I found it.

Splinter watches martial arts YOUTUBE VIDEOS.

Splinter and the Turtles train, having fun.

As the years pass, the Turtles and their ninja skills grow.
Splinter finishes the story, the Turtles rapt with attention.

We thought we needed the human
          world, but we only need each other.
          That's why I'm so strict! Ya know!?
          You boys are all I got. And you are
          all I'll ever have!

I do! You know other mutants my
          age? It's a really small pool.
          There's no apps to meet other
          mutant ladies! Trust me! I check
          everyday!

The Turtles look away, not so sure how lucky they are.

Look, I really don't want to do
          this. No leaving the sewer for one
          month.

Yeah yeah yeah yeah, I made up my
          mind. That's it, I'm done.

This hits Raph hard. He storms off- pissed.

Shut up Leo!

Raph pushes him off. Donnie and Mikey sadly follow Raph.

Was it worth it Mr. Leader?

Splinter looks away sadly.

elements.name: b
elements.content: INT. THE SEWERS - THE TURTLES' ROOM - LATER
The four Turtles lay in their beds.

Hey guys, if we weren't monsters
          that were shunned by society and we
          could actually do what we wanted...
          what would you guys do?

I mean... If I'm being honest...
          I'd just be normal. You know?
Yeah... like go to high school...

Maybe... get a girlfriend. Go to
          prom?

I just gotta get out of this sewer
          man! I like you guys and all, but I
          simply cannot live a happy life
          knowing that your faces are the
          last things I'm gonna see before I
          die!

Well guess what guys... it's never
          gonna happen. So let's just stop
          talking about it, alright?

They roll over to go to sleep.
WE SEE a THUG in an ICE CREAM TRUCK parked on the street.

Alright focus up... the truck
          containing the radioactive storage
          unit is one minute out.

We see two more THUGS up the block. They're dressed as
construction workers.

Let's not mess this up guys.
          Superfly doesn't take kindly to
          errors.

Any idea what he's building with
          all this weird equipment?

Who cares? Hey as long as the check
          clears, am I right?

Target's approaching.

We see an ARMORED TRUCK approaching. The construction THUGS
throw TIRE POPPING TRACKS across the road!

Ahhh!

The truck ROLLS OVER THEM - and CRASHES!

Sixty seconds till police response.

The ICE CREAM TRUCK backs up to the back of the armored car
as the two construction guys put EXPLOSIVES on the hinges of
the door. They BLOW it off and carry the Device into the Ice
Cream Truck! It's pretty SEAMLESS!

30 seconds we gotta move!

Everyone PILES in the ICE CREAM TRUCK and they PEEL OFF!!
The thugs are CELEBRATING as they SPEED away from the scene.

Hey let's not get carried away.
          Hey, hey everybody keep your cool!

A COP CAR turns its lights and siren on and chases after
them.

Cops!

They SPEED AWAY, making some CRAZY TURNS, the cops hot on
their tail! They reach a roadblock with more cops waiting for
them.

Guys there's no way out of this,
          what're we gonna do?

Superfly's gonna kill us!

The COP SPEEDS TOWARDS THEM-

In pursuit of suspects moving south
          on Broadway.

-when suddenly - the WHOLE ICE CREAM TRUCK is LIFTED off the
ground and into the sky!

The truck flies through the city, weaving between
skyscrapers.

elements.name: b
elements.content: EXT. STATEN ISLAND BOAT GRAVEYARD - MOMENTS LATER

The Ice Cream Truck is DROPPED onto a decrepit freighter. The
THUGS recover, disoriented.

Oh man what is this place?

The back door is TORN open and we see the thugs RECOIL in

Superfly.

Cut wide as the thugs SCREAM in terror and the truck rocks
back and forth.

Superfly's machine parallaxes into frame. It reads "TCRI."

WE SEE   MUTANT GENETIC BLUEPRINTS on old CHARRED pieces of
paper.   We PAN off it and move through a lab - past DOZENS of
failed   experiments. We land on Cynthia, seated at her control
panel,   deep in thought.

SPIDER comes in.

It happened again. One of our
            trucks got hit - they stole a
            radioactive storage unit this time.

Cynthia presses a few keys and a NEWS REPORT plays on her
screen. She SEES the ICE CREAM TRUCK flying away.

Flying ice cream? Another robbery
            today in midtown Manhattan. New
            Yorkers were stunned.

Cynthia looks over to the FLY schematic - clearly RECOVERED
from Stockman's lab. Something OCCURS to her.

Put tracking devices on all
          shipments. It's time we met this...
          Superfly.
We open on home video footage: Raph is holding a sword.
Yeah! Yeah! Lob it up! Lob it up!
Hold on hold on hold on!

Now now now!

Whip to Mikey lobbing a watermelon at him, Raph slices it in
half mid-air. It looks AWESOME.

Come on guys we JUST got
          ungrounded, let's go home.
Hey Leo can I ask you a question?

Is it weird to have your head so
          far up dad's butt?
Does it smell weird up there?

I bet it smells like cheese and
          Doritos.
Ha, ha, ha guys. Very funny.
What? Sorry, we can't hear you!

Your voice is too muffled through
          the cheeks!!

Hey why don't you try that Batman
          voice again?!

Yo! Check this out in slo-mo!

They watch the video and REACT.

Dude! That's the coolest thing I've
          ever seen!

Hey, let's try that again but with
          ninja stars!

Okay, eye of the tiger, Raph. Nice
          and easy.

Focus up, focus up. Come on, come
          on, you're good.

Guys? Do I have to be the one to
          hold this?
Who else is gonna do it Mikey?

Don't worry about it Mikey, you're
          fine! Chill!
              (to Leo)
          He's gonna die.

Hey why did we pick a fruit shaped
          exactly like my head?

Your head looks like Stewie had a
          baby with Hey Arnold!

Just stop talking, you're ruining
          my concentration!

Ah!

He tosses a ninja star at the watermelon. It SLICES right
through it and falls off the building, hitting someone-

Did you hear that? What was that?

They hurry to the edge of the roof.

elements.name: b
elements.content: EXT. LOOKING OVER THE EDGE OF THE BUILDING - CONTINUOUS

Down at street level a teenage girl has the ninja star stuck
in her helmet, but she's okay. This is APRIL O'NEIL. Leo
watches April, time slowing down to super slo-motion.

Hey! You on the roof! You just hit
          me in the head with a ninja star!!
          I've had a lot of messed up things
          happen to me, but this?!
She's yelling at us a LOT.

I think she's mad that we hit her
          with a ninja star.

Hey maybe we should go down and
          talk to her, ya know? Check in on
          her?

The others mock him.
Just to make sure she's okay.

No! Don't side bar! This is one of
          the most populated cities on planet
          Earth! Alright? You can't be
          running around recklessly with
          weapons!

While April is busy yelling, a dude in a hoodie walks up.

I think that guy is helping     I think he's stealing her
her.                            scooter.

Actually we can skip the
          conversation, you can just cut me a
          check. You owe me money!

No, your scooter!

April notices her scooter is being stolen.

What!? No! Hey! Hey! What are you
          doing?!
Don't honk at me honk at him!

Well, we tried to warn her, nothing
          more we can do. You guys want to
          grab pizza or-

The thief rides off with the scooter and April's backpack.

No no no, guys she got her scooter
          stolen and it's our fault, we have
          to fix this!

Yeah man that sucks but...DO we
          have to fix this? I mean
          technically she was just at the
          wrong place at the wrong time, I
          mean it's not really our fault...

Exactly yeah...

The camera pushes in on Leo's face.

I gotta get this scooter back to
          this beautiful and charming human
          woman!!!
              (to the guys)
          Alpha formation!! GO!!

Leo LEAPS off the building, chasing after the thief.

Whoah! I think all of his hormones
          just kicked in at once.

Follow him!

They follow after him, landing on the street. April hears a
thud but doesn't see them.
They follow the thief up to a Chop Shop where he runs inside.

Alright guys, guard the exits.
          We're gonna need the most foolproof
          plan. Every single ninja technique.
          Alright, I need you to use stealth
          to block the doors-
Did you say go in LOUD? WHOOOO!

Stop stop-

Raph BUSTS in the front door with his sais out.
They are in a chop shop surrounded by scary looking thugs.

That's a lotta guys. They look
          really mean.
What the heck are those things?

I think it's those guys who work in
          Times Square. You know, the
          mascots? Yeah. The Geico Geckos.

They look more like little Shreks
          to me.

This is fine. Ya know, we've
          prepared our whole lives for this.
Leo gulps. This ISN'T fine. They're all freaked out.

We've never actually    been in a
          fight before...and I    don't know if
          you noticed, but all    I've got is a
          big stick. How did I    end up with a
          big stick?!

Maybe we diffuse this sitch with
          laughter?

You're not funny enough for that,
          dude.

Enough talk! I dream about fighting
          every night!
You've got a rage problem, Raph.

Raph charges at the bad guys but immediately slips on oil and
goes down.

Rogue sai!

One of Raph's sais flies into Donnie's LEG!

Oh my god, oh my- I'm gonna be
          sick.

Mikey groans, woozy.

Mikey watch out!!

A fire extinguisher whizzes through the air and knocks all of
them down into a pile.

Ugh... ok we're not uh- we're not
          off to a great start guys.

Maybe they'll see the humanity in
          our tragic backstory.

They don't see it! They don't see
          it!

The thugs charge at them.

Hey what are you doing! No!

Raph launches Leo towards the guy. He lands a flying kick to
his face!

Alright Raph, you go left, I go-

Raph ignores him, knocking the thug to the ground.
What the heck man, I said go left.

I got him!

Raph's hit from behind as more thugs come after them.

Mikey runs, sliding over a car. He tries to get in but it's
locked! A thug narrowly misses him with a CROWBAR that breaks
the passenger window.

Ah! Oh snap! Too slow! Psych!

Surrounded, Mikey LEAPS, doing a backflip over the thugs and
crashes through the sun roof of the car.

The RADIO turns on playing Vanilla Ice's "Ninja Rap."

The horn blares.

Dang that's loud.

He hops out and runs across the room, passing Donnie.

Back off! I've got a big stick! Ah!

A guy lunges at him. Donnie pushes a wheel cart towards him,
tripping him up. His head SLAMS into a nearby car.

Another thug aims a gun at Raph. Donnie throws a wrench at
him, causing him to miss and fire at the ceiling.

What the?!

Raph sets his sights on a thug who's immediately terrified.

Sorry, sorry...

Raph THROWS him across the room. Leo gets hit in the face
with something.
Ow! Guys quit throwing stuff at me!

What do we do? What do we do?!

Mikey grabs the fire extinguisher to combat the flames.

Save the scooter!! Save the
          beautiful human woman's scooter!!

VROOOOM!!! A thug revs a car, headlights on the turtles.

Uh oh.

Mikey JUMPS over the car.

Ate that no crumbs!

The guy keeps trying to hit them with the car-

Okay chill out chill out.

-they keep dodging, but it's getting really close.

Ah!

Donnie throws his staff through the steering wheel locking
the car in a hard right turn. It starts spinning around in
donuts in the middle of the shop.

He's Tokyo Drifting around us!!

Raphael springs into action, hops on the roof, reaches in and
puts the car in neutral. Its spins to a stop as Raph lands.

Yeah Raph!

The thug looks woozy-

Guys- look around!

The Turtles see all the bad guys are down for the count. Leo
is BEAMING. They did it- they knocked everyone down.

THAT?!?!?!?!?!/I totally helped!

Suddenly someone lifts open the garage door.    The turtles
whip around, like deer in headlights!

elements.content: WE SEE EVERYTHING DESCRIBED IN THE STORY OF THEIR ORIGIN:

My earliest memory in the world is
          my dad telling me that he never was
          accepted... he just wanted a family
          man. That's why he created us. But
          then...that's when the people he
          worked for sent the ops through.
          They took it from him. I rescued my
          little baby brother and sister, and
          since I was the oldest, ya know, I
          had to raise them.

WE SEE THEM SETTLE DOWN in the SHIP GRAVEYARD. THEY WATCH an
ad for an ITALIAN RESTAURANT on TV.

Anyway... We thought... these
          humans, yeah they murdered our dad,
          but, maybe they just ain't ALL bad,
          you know?
              (beat)
          We went out and we hit the town.
          And... it didn't go well.
          Especially this one dude man... he
          wouldn't stop chasing us. He wanted
          to kill us!

Oh my god that's what happened to
          us!

That's why our dad made us live in
          the sewer our whole lives.

Well not me! That sounds like a
          punk choice. You know what I did?
          I beat that fool down. I touched
          that chin, molly whopped him! Wop
          wop. To an inch of his life. Bop!

Superfly CRUSHES a bottle of ketchup. It splatters all over.

And then, I knew what to do. I
          decided to kill ALL the humans, and
          let the MUTANTS RULE THE EARTH!!

The Turtles stare at him in shock.

I inherited my dad's mind for
          science and I thought, what if I
          built a machine to enact my plan!?
          I've been stealing all the parts
          that I need, and now, I'm ready!
              (beat)
          I'm gonna use a little of my blood
          to create a weaponized version of
          the ooze, then we gonna LAUNCH it
          into the atmosphere and watch it

Here's the kicker, every animal on
          EARTH will be transformed into a
          mutant. Every fly, flea, tick,
          snake, fish and whale. Everything!
          And we become the dominant species
          on earth.

(listening in)
          That's bad! That's very bad. For
          me.

Wait what happens to humans in this
          plan of yours?

We wish there was another way to
          feel safe and happy, but
          peoples...they gotsta go.

A bunch of `em gonna be eaten,
          enslaved, turned into a fuel of
          some sort. Maybe they'll become a
          form of entertainment, know what I
          mean? You know how they used to
          have the dog shows and the horse
          races? Well maybe we'll have red
          head shows, fat booty boy races.
          Baby tossing. Something like that,
          you know, I'll think of something
          stupid.
Superfly GETS UP and WALKS OUT - EVERYONE FOLLOWS.

Honestly I'm open to all ideas. You
          know what I mean?

Any crazy thing ya'll think of I
          want to do it. You know what I
          mean? Just pitch it as soon as
          possible.

He MOTIONS to the GIANT STORAGE DEVICE from the back of the
van...

Cus now that I got   this, I can
          complete my device   and...
          acceptance will be   ourssszzz.

The mutants cheer. The turtles look to each other.

So what's up, you wanna roll with
          us? Cus we can activate the machine
          tonight!

Yeah!/Take over!/Yay Fillet!/Yeah
          little dudes! Yeah!

Hey... just checking in, you
          stopping them now? Or you gonna
          make me film you supplying an evil
          villain with the last piece of his
          horrible puzzle? You're gonna stop
          him?! You're gonna stop him.
          Somebody? Just talk so I know
          you're gonna stop him.

(to Superfly)
          Yo uh Superfly... So what if we're
          actually, like... I dunno I'm just
          like, I'm getting silly here, what
          if we're not into the plan? What if
          we don't like it, what would
          happen?

Yeah just hypothetically speaking,
          obviously.

Superfly stops and TURNS slowly to the turtles.

Well... that would mean that I was
          wrong about you. And you're all not
          as cool as I thought you was.

And that right there... would piss
          me off.

Superfly STOMPS on a FIRE HYDRANT, CRUSHING it like a tin
can.
I'm about to go to 100 on y'all.

Man don't cuz me right now man!
          Drop that man, that's got nothing
          to do with that.

Listen man, we were just joking
          around because we are in fact very
          into your plan. It's like great. I
          love the killing people part.

(to the turtles)
          Guys I got an idea.
              (to Superlfly)
          So uh, S-fly my man, we'll drive
          the van with the storage unit, and
          you lead the way!

Cool, but I drive fast, and I don't
          want y'all to get lost. So Mondo,
          Wingnut, Rock, ride with the
          tortoises.
You're uhh, you're good to drive?

(laughing) No!

The turtles get in the back of the van TRAPPED and TERRIFIED.
Mondo Gecko pulls away.

The turtles whisper in the back. Mondo and Wingnut are
arguing about what to play on the radio.
Jam bands are the best bro!

No, jam is something you put on
          toast!

Hey dudes, fun cruising with you
          but...where are we going exactly?

Oh see that building over there?
          That's not it. Haha no, we're going
          to the this super cool shipping
          graveyard over in Staten Island.
          It's the best borough, bro.
APRIL FOLLOWS THE CARS on her scooter, struggling to keep up!

Okay, it's go time! Attack these
          fools!

(whispering)
          Not sure that's as easy as it
          sounds. I mean this dude is
          literally a rhinoceros man.

I gots an idea. How about something
          we can all sing along to?!!

"What's Up" by 4 Non Blondes comes on the radio.

(whispering)
          But look if we jam the breaks,
          they'll just fly out the front of
          the car. There's no windshield or
          anything.

It's impossible. We'd need like a
          long and narrow device that's small
          enough to get under the seat, but
          strong enough to press the pedal.
They're all singing along to the radio.

elements.name: b
elements.content: ...AND I STEP OUTSIDE AND I TAKE A

elements.name: b
elements.content: DEEP BREATH AND I GET REAL HIGH AND

elements.name: b
elements.content: I SCREAM FROM THE TOP OF MY LUNGS

Then- Donnie's stick slides UNDER THE SEAT and JAMS THE
BREAKS! THEY'RE SINGING THE WHOLE TIME. They FLY OUT THE
FRONT OF THE CAR, HITTING THE ROAD. As MONDO FLIES - HE LOOKS

Sooorrrryyyyyyy....

ANGLE ON: SUPERFLY - seeing the VAN MAKE A HARD TURN AND
SPEED off, the MUTANTS left on the ground.
Hey you hurt Rock, I hurt you!
Donnie DRIVES AS FAST AS HE CAN!

The turtles SPEED down the road. April is on a PARALLEL road,
watching the action unfold.

Don't worry guys! I got this!!

Scumbug appears and PUKES all over the turtles, then flies
away!

I don't got this! I don't got this!


He SWERVES AROUND!!

Bebop's BRONCO pulls up alongside the turtles van.

You're dead, tortoises!!

Donnie SWERVES them into parked cars-

Ah! Woah! Hey no!

-but Bebop easily drives over them.

You can't stop me it's a monster
          truck dummos! Get `em Mondo!!!

Mondo Gecko leaps onto the roof.

Yo dudes! You launched me out of
          the front of that van! That is not
          cool!
I'm so sorry, we had to!!!

You know what? I don't accept that
          apology!

Yeah I'm not sorry at all, I'm not
          gonna lie!

Woahh!!!

Raph punches Mondo in the face sending him flying from the
car. Mondo lands on his TAIL ROLLER-SKATE and keeps a grip on
the bumper.

On the other side, Rocksteady sideswipes them with his
motorcycle. LEATHERHEAD tries to get on board the van from
her motorcycle!
Hey I'm back ya green punks!

Stop it ya bloody hooligans or I'll
          bite ya bloody heads off!

WINGNUT SWOOPS in front of the van!

Superfly is almost here and he's
          not going to be as nice about this!

He'll be less nice!!

Superfly floors it, catching up to them.

It's now or never dudes! Give us
          the device!

Superfly effortlessly RIPS the back off the van.

Donnie adjusts the rearview mirror and sees him, HUGE and

6 in the morning, police at my
          door.

Superfly punches Raph in the face, knocking him unconscious.

Leo tries to draw a sword but it gets stuck in the roof of
the van! Superfly grabs his other sword and pins Leo against
the wall.

Michelango pulls out his nunchucks. Superfly snips the chain
making them USELESS.

Guys?

Superfly RIPS the steering wheel off!

He grabs Donnies BO STAFF and PUSHES Donnie's foot against
the accelerator, wedging it agains the ceiling!

No! He used my stick against me!!!!
          Ah! Now he's molly-whopping me!

Man, I almost thought y'all was
          cool. See you in hell turtles!

Quick grab it!

Leo lunges out of the van, grabbing one end of the device
while Superfly firmly holds the other. Mikey grabs Leo by the
legs, trying to to reel him back in.

Goochi, goochi, goo.

Superfly flies away with the Device, the hot rods peel off
into the night and the turtles CRASH off of a freeway
overpass.

Ahhhh!!!

They land on the street, front first, TOTALING the van just
as TCRI pulls up on them.

The turtles stumble from the wreckage. The soldiers look at
them.

Go go go go! Surround them, make a
          perimeter!

The turtles see APRIL on the overpass-

April... Help...

But she SPEEDS OFF!!

Say goodnight, freak.

Spider hits Leo in the face as we see his POV fade to black.

The turtles COME TO - in an industrial-sized laboratory -
hooked up to a MASSIVE MACHINE!!!

Wha...what? What's happening? Hey!
          Let us out! Come on!

A HUGE SECURITY TEAM guards them, heavily armed.

Out steps CYNTHIA UTROM.

Why hello turtles. I've been
          looking for you for a long, long
          time.

Look, lady! I don't know what you
          want from us, or why you talk so
          scary, but we shouldn't be in here!
          There's a fly monster--

Utrom hit's a button that SHOCKS Donnie!

I will do the talking. I am Cynthia
          Utrom... and you are my property.

Enough! I will use you to create a
          stable mutagen.
              (beat)

And with that - I will create an
          army of Super Soldiers! Dolphin men
          to plant bombs on submarines -

She PROJECTS a holographic DOLPHIN MAN blueprint.

...Eagle men to fight enemy jets -

She shows an EAGLE MAN blueprint.

...Snake men to SLITHER behind
          enemy lines...

She shows a SNAKE MAN blueprint.

They all have MECHANICAL ELECTRODES hooked up to them - it
looks CRONENEBERG-ESQUE and FREAKY.

The glory of it all nearly brings
          me to tears.
What does this have to do with us?!
Yeah! What do you want from us?

What I want... is your blood. And
          there's only one way to get it.

Hook them up to the milking
          machine.

Ahh!/Dad was right!/She's gonna
          milk us!

A few gentle guitar notes are solemnly heard. A beautiful
somber and slowed down rendition of WHAT'S UP begins, sung
with an unbelievably beautiful voice.

(singing)
          And so I cry sometimes when I'm
          lying in bed.

Wingnut, Leatherhead and Bebop work diligently.

Superfly LANDS in his LAB holding the equipment.

(singing)
          Just to get it all out what's in my
          head.

Superfly starts connecting pieces of the machine, hurrying
towards completion.

And I, I am feeling a little
          peculiar.

THE CAMERA slowly reveals a MASSIVE, TERRIFYING DOOMSDAY
MACHINE. Superfly has a look of evil determination in his
eyes. The mutants have a sad look in their eyes.

(singing)
          And so I wake in the morning-

Ray Fillet, man shut your mouth! If
          I wanted to be sad, I'd go listen
          to some damn John Legend.

We reveal Mondo is on the guitar with Ray Fillet singing
beside him.

Remember this is a happy day!
          Because we're gonna kill every
          human on this big ol' ugly Earth!
          So smile Mondo!

Superfly stares at his machine, a look of madness in his
eyes, whereas the mutants exchange sad looks of worry.

Splinter sits alone, watching the party balloons deflate. He
thumbs through family photos. In one, he and the kids are
happy. In the next, they're teenagers and look miserable.

Splinter sighs. Then, hears footsteps behind him.

Boys? You came home? You forgive
          me? My surprise party worked?

He turns to see April.
Ah! GET BACK! I'll bite you!!

Heyyyy Mr. Rat...man... I'm April,
          I, uh, I come in peace! I'm friends
          with your sons.

Splinter is confused by this.
And right now, they're in trouble.
Ahh! No no no no! Stop it! Ahhh!

Of courses it hurts!! She's milking
          me!!!

WE SEE his OOZE BLOOD draining out of him via tubes.

Try to think of something pleasant
          to take your mind off the pain!

Yeah yeah! Think of pizza Mikey!
          Think of the pizza!

No! Pizza's made of cheese! And
          cheese is made of MILK! And I'm
          being milked!! It's infiltrated my
          every thought!! AHHH!!

I'm so sorry Mikey!

Utrom gestures to a GIANT CONTAINER filling slowly with his
ooze blood.

Continue milking them until we have
          the required amount.
She LEAVES. RAPH STARTS getting milked.

Well, this is it guys. We're gonna
          die here getting milked to death in
          a lab!

The GRAVITY REALLY starts to hit them.

I can't believe April just left
          us... I mean... Maybe she was just
          using us...

The hang their heads.

Well she ended up getting a great
          story. "Turtle boys GIVE
          supervillain last part of his evil
          machine..."

You know that's actually a pretty
          good title I guess.
I'd definitely give that a read.
I wish I could tried frozen yogurt!
I know! And I blew it!
I just wish I could see BTS IRL.

We could do some of the songs for
          you.

(singing)
                Smooth like butter...come on guys.

      THEY ALL SING "BUTTER" by BTS TO DONNIE.

You guys don't even know the words.

      And then... THE LIGHTS ALL GO OUT in the ROOM!! All the
      GUARDS OUTSIDE THE CELL take a DEFENSIVE POSE.
690   Utrom sees an alarm go off. TCRI Guard rushes in the room.

elements.name: b
elements.content: (MAKE SURE UTROM IS NOT SCARED AND USHERED AWAY, BUT THAT SHE

elements.name: b
elements.content: IS A SCARY BOSS WALKING OFF WITH CONFIDENCE)

Moving Ms. Utrom to a secure
                location.
The guards search around for the unseen intruder. Splinter

Stay back everyone! Stay back! I'm
                just here for my boys, who lied to
                me! They are in so much trouble
                right now!

Oh is that so, Ratatouille? Grab
          another machine and hook him up
          like the others.

Don't call me Ratatouille.

It's an UNBELIEVABLE DISPLAY of ninja skills!! He kicks the
living shit out of all the guards in the room!! It's insane.

Where you gonna run to rat?

EVEN MORE GUARDS SHOW UP - Splinter has to genuinely FIGHT
FOR HIS LIFE. He uses the objects in the lab and the
environment itself.

A guard SHOCKS HIM and another THROWS HIM against a storage
locker which FALLS DIRECTLY ON TOP OF HIM.

The Turtles GASP.

Then-- a SWORD rips through the side of the locker. Splinter
emerges dawning ALL OF THE TURTLES' DIFFERENT WEAPONS!

He uses them to finish off the guards, who don't stand a
chance. Finally, he's victorious.

He HITS the control panel and RELEASES the turtles.

Yes!/We're good!/Thank god!/We're
          more than okay.

How did you find us?!!

April COMES IN THROUGH a vent!

Listen, I'd be a pretty big piece
          of crap if I didn't at least try to
          get your dad to come help you.

This human told me you lied to me.
          What happened?! What have you been
          doing?!

Wait a minute. What is this
          machine?

No! / It's the opposite of that!/
          Does it?
See! I told you they'd milk you!

Boys you left the sewer and got
          milked! You helped some evil fly
          man create a machine that is gonna
          destroy the world, and kill the
          only good human, April. So we're
          going to clean up your mess then go
          home and stay there forever, ok?

Forget the story! April, go home!
          It's over! Ok?

There's only one way for you to be
          safe and happy, and that's LISTEN
          TO ME! Let's go.

They leave the building - April goes one way, the turtles and
Splinter go the other.

Sorry we couldn't help you get Prom
          un-cancelled.

Nah, it's alright. Seeing you guys
          make so many mistakes just to get
          people to like you made me realize
          I was definitely doing this for the
          wrong reason.

April walks over to her scooter, which has a flat tire.

Oh, perfect.

More guards arrive at TCRI on motorcycles. They run inside.

Backup arriving now! Sealing off
          the entrance.
April eyes the bikes left unattended.

The turtles and Splinter ARRIVE at the boat graveyard. They
CAUTIOUSLY APPROACH the only boat the has LIGHT EMITTING FROM

The turtles and splinter DROP into the ship, READY FOR
ACTION. But to their surprise - there's NOBODY AROUND.

Maybe they decided to just like,
          give up and go bowling again?

Naaahhh fam...nah!

Superfly and his crew EMERGE from the shadows.
We just one step ahead of y'all!

Hey what's up bros?

The surround the turtles and Splinter.

I don't want to fight another
          mutant, but I will!

Y'all just won't quit huh? What is
          it about these stinkin' humans that
          you love so much??

Humans are complicated creatures!
          They're good, like April! And bad -
          like that lady who milked us!

As much as I don't like them, and
          trust me, I do NOT like them - if
          we kill them, we are no better than
          they are!

I REFUSE to accept that you all are
          cool with brutally killing all of
          them! You just can't be! You're
          awesome! You're fun. We... vibed.

You're not killers! I mean come on,
          look at you!

But it's the only way we'll be
          accepted!

We accept you!

This lands with the mutants.

You can come live with us! We
          accept you!

Yes! Plenty of room!

The mutants all look to each other.

I kinda don't want to murder
          everyone on Earth. And I kinda just
          want to sing. Ray Fillet!

Yeah it's a good point. I'd rather
          not murder tons of people, cus
          like, what if I'm haunted by the
          faces of my victims in my sleep?

Bro, you'll...you'll really let us
          live with you?

What the hell ya'll doing?!! Man,
          stop this kumba-ya I love each
          other stuff. Kill them fools!

Mondo cowers for a brief fearful moment, then rallies his
courage. He throws down his crowbar.

Uh, no, we don't wanna do this! And
          really, I don't think we ever did!
          We just didn't know there was any
          alternative, but now that we met
          these dudes we see that... there
          IS! So let's just stop and vibe!

The mutants nod in agreement.
Give me a V a V, a vibe!

Nah man I don't vibe. And you don't
          either. Now GET IN LINE!

Turn off the machine.

Superfly stares at his mutant crew, filling with anger.

My own family. Turned against me.
          After everything I done for
          ya'll...
              (stone cold)
          Look, bottom line: if you wanna
          stop this machine, you've got to go
          through me.

Superfly presses buttons on the machine, powering it up and
pointing it at downtown Manhattan.

I think this guy's been making me
          angry my whole LIFE!

Oh my gosh...
              (realizing)
          I think he's the REASON we're
          angry!
We gonna do something bout it!?!

Yeah get him Rock!

Superfly grabs Rocksteady and tosses him.

Not my nose ring! No!

Genghis shoots his tongue onto Superfly's face, flying at
him.

Wingnut flies at the machine, trying to disable it. Superfly
grabs her.

Ah the machine! This is our chance
          come on! Ah!

Superfly flies up and attacks. She grabs him-

Get off me!

-and he sends her flying!

Leatherhead SNAPS at Superfly who narrowly dodges it. Ray
Fillet swoops in behind.

Ray Fillet!

The mutants tackle Superfly to the ground. He shakes them off
and gets back up.

Leo and Donnie rush towards the machine.

We gotta break it! Just like, I
          dunno, throw it against the wall or
          something!

Try to rip it out! Get it get it!

Superfly grabs Michelangelo and hits him repeatedly.

Surprise! Why you socking yourself?
          Why you socking yourself?

You might as well give up! Watch
          out!

Superfly beats down Ray Fillet.

They smile in your face, all the
          time they wanna take your place.

The group rallies and charges at him! The mutants all WRESTLE
Superfly. THEY START TO SUBDUE HIM!

Splinter PICKS HIMSELF UP. Superfly sees him.

What's goin on? Why are you all
          doing this?! There's only one way
          for you to feel safe and happy,
          that's if you listen to me!

This triggers Splinter.

Rat man! Come on, help me out! Look
          man, we're basically the same! We
          both hate humans! I'm just not a
          punk about it like you!

Don't you say that!

He CHARGES SUPERFLY!! HE HITS THE MACHINE. The machine starts
to CRASH through the freighter!

They all watch as the machine and Superfly sink into the
ocean...

Geez dad, you really went buck wild
          there.

BUT - the MACHINE that was dumped in the WATER starts to
RUMBLE from deep under the ocean.

Hey when a machine that turns a
          bunch of animals into mutants goes
          off underwater, um, and then
          there's animals in the water, um
          like what do you think that does?

The water GLOWS GREEN.

The mutants get to the top of the freighter and watch as a
DISTURBANCE in the WATER heads towards MANHATTAN.

elements.name: b
elements.content: A HUGE MONSTER EMERGES FROM THE WATER.

It's ok, things flop onto the shore
          all the time!

elements.name: b
elements.content: THEN STEPS INTO THE ZOO, GAINING LEGS AND ARMS.

Oh my god!/Yeah that's
          bad!/AH!/That got way worse!

It ROARS, emerging from the zoo.

Oh HELLLL YEAHHHHHH!!!! LOOK AT ME.
          Look at me! This is amazing! I
          ain't just Superfly. I'm SUPERDUPER
          FLY! You know what I mean? I mean
          Missy Elliot superduperfly. I'm on
          some Godzilla- what the hell? Is
          that a... is that a whale tail? Aww.
          I got a claw, I got a whale body,
          giraffe forehead...Look at my
          feets! They're made of horses! Man
          I'm about to have a BALL with this.
          Thank you turtles!!!! Thank you, ya
          lil' tortoises.
He starts flying into downtown Manhattan.
Agape, the turtles watch the mutant from afar.

Alright, well... we gave it a shot.
          Back to the sewer? I got pizza
          tonight for dinner....

We can't stop that thing! We
          couldn't stop him before he became
          that thing!
What, so we just go home?
I bet the army will be here soon!

According to every Godzilla movie,
          they'll eventually get here.

So, you guys got like a good Wi-Fi
          situation down there? Like are you
          fully able to stream or uh?

Not that!

He faces the turtles.

Boys - I messed up. I don't want to
          be like Superfly. I love you boys.
          I want you to be happy.

Even though I don't like humans, I
          want them to like you because YOU
          want them to like you. (beat) So
          we're gonna get that monster. We're
          gonna take him down. We're gonna
          film it and we're gonna show it to
          the world. And the world will love
          you and accept you! And the world
          will cheer turtles turtles
          turtles!!!

The turtles are deeply moved by Splinter's words.

Oh man, I'm feeling GREAT after
          that speech right?

It was rousing. I'm fully roused,
          ya know?
Little bit of a buzzkill here but-

How do we do that??

Donnie's phone rings. It's April.

Hey! What am I looking at? What
          happened to the whole "stop
          Superfly" thing? We not doing that
          or what's up?

April can see Superfly: Mega Mutant from her window.

SO much has changed since we last
          spoke.

Yeah obviously.

He hands the phone to Leo.

It's a lot to catch up on, okay?
          But first, do you mayyyyyyyybeeeee
          know any ways we might be able to
          stop that thing?

April looks at the TCRI motorcycle in her driveway equipped
with an anti-mutant gun.

Oh, I actually might have
          something...Meet me at the leg
          of... the thing we're all looking
          at...right? Cool.

QUICK CUTS - THE MOTORCYCLE's engine getting REVVED, throttle
getting TURNED, WHEELS SCREECHING - APRIL RIPS down the road
on the bike with the ANTI-MUTAGEN GUN in tow.

IN A GLORIOUS SHOT - WE SEE Wingnut carrying Bebop and
Rocksteady, one in each hand. Scumbug, flying with a CARGO
NET that holds Splinter and the Turtles. Leatherhead swims
next to Ray Fillet, who Mondo Gecko surfs on. Genghis Frog
HOPS out of the water periodically as he keeps up!

WE SEE the turtles all smooshed together in the cargo net.

This is not triumphant at all.

Some Scumbug goop DRIPS on to Donnie.
The MUTANT crew LAND in the city and SPRING into action.

They turn to see APRIL on the motorcycle RIPPING TOWARDS
THEM! She AKIRA SLIDES to a STOP right in front of them.

She tosses the ANTIDOTE GUN to RAPH and RUN towards Superfly:
Mega Mutant!!

New York, New York! I'm here baby!
          Ya'll thought it was gonna be
          Godzilla? Nah!

Raph gets into position.

Woo ok let's go, eye of the tiger,
          come on. You got this Raph. You're
          awesome.

The others encourage him and give him pointers.
Close one eye, I heard that helps.

[misc words of encouragement]

He takes the shot and it hits Superfly: Mega Mutant!
Is that it did you do it?

We're good right?

ONE horse falls off of Superfly: Mega Mutant and runs away.

That's it? One little horse? I
          don't need that horse.

Superfly: Mega Mutant TURNS AROUND and sees our crew.

That didn't do what I thought it
          would.

Oh my god it's running at us. Oh my
          god! Oh my god! Leo do something!

Run run run!

He KICKS a bus and it FLIES at them. They DIVE for cover as
it SMASHES down, EXPLODING!!!

WE SEE MIKEY'S EYES OPEN - it's like SAVING PRIVATE RYAN. The
street is like a WAR ZONE.

What did the claw say to the face?
          Smack!

Wingnut FLIES and is SWATTED out of the sky.

Bebop tries to free Rocksteady from underneath an ambulance.

Rocksteady! Buddy are you okay?

Mikey sees mondo's TAIL under some rubble.

Mondo!

He pulls at it and is horrified to see its JUST A TAIL!
MONDO runs by in the BG.

It's ok! It grows back! See?

WE SEE it SPROUT back!

Mikey!!!

Mikey turns to see Donnie stumbling his way!

Donnie!

Superfly: Mega Mutant HURLS a car a Donnie. RAPH appears,
SHOVING Donnie out of the way, just in time. CRASH!

Where's dad? Where's April?

Another CAR is thrown at them! It crashes in front of Leo as
he LEAPS out of the way, landing with his brothers!

He's gonna run out of cars
          eventually!

Superfly: Mega Mutant turns to a full CAR GARAGE right next
to him.

You like these rides right here?

They all RUN!!
Oh the Mercedes E class, no!
That one's a Prius, it's okay.

Look out! A tesla! Somebody's mad
            about that.

They jump into a BUS to hide-

I think we lost him-

-but Superfly: Mega Mutant KICKS the BUS! They go flying
through the air and land in Times Square!
Uhhhh! Hit that from the back!

The turtles LAND - DAZED.

They pull themselves out of the bus... to see EVERYONE
HORRIFIED of them. ALL THE SCREENS in the city have various
news outlets reporting on the mutant attack. "MUTANTS ATTACK

You good guys? (looks up) Oh no.

On one screen:

Monstrous mutants are rampaging
            through downtown New York! The only
            question is do we capture them for
            experimentation, or kill them on
            site? Taking calls now!

On ANOTHER SCREEN -

If you're just joining us, mutants
            are attacking the city.

On ANOTHER SCREEN -

A rash of monsters in New York is
            taking over Times Square.

We don't know what they are but
          there WILL be a military response.

-are threatening to take a bite out
          of the Big Apple.
One thing I know? I hate mutants!

We hate mutants! We hate mutants!

A scared MOTHER ushers her DAUGHTER away from the turtles.

Yeah, I don't think this is gonna
          go down how we wanted it to...

No, worse. They think we're
          monsters.

Look, guys, April was right. We
          were doing this for the wrong
          reasons. I know we only wanted to
          be heroes to be accepted, but even
          though it looks like we'll never be
          accepted...I still think we should
          try to be heroes.

But how? Every plan we've had has
          failed.

Plan?! YOU'RE complaining we don't
          have a plan?! Mikey - What do you
          do better than ANYONE? Even Mark
          Ruffalo?

Says the guy who has read more
          comics where people are fighting
          giant monsters than anyone on

You MUST be able to think of a way
          to stop something like that!

Donnie looks around, thinking. WE PUSH IN ON HIM.

Of COURSE! Attack on Titan! Giant
          monsters attack and they have ONE
          WEAKNESS! On the backs of their
          necks!

Yes! And, the blowhole is exactly
          that!!

That's it!

He picks up the LAST VIAL of anti-ooze from the gun.

If we can get THIS thing into that
          thing's blowhole, it'll go in it's
          bloodstream! I bet it'll demutanize
          it!

There ya go! Demutanize the big
          monster! And Raph... It's time to
          go loud.

REAL LOUD! As loud as you've ever
          gone. Use that rage of yours! Use
          it to help us!!!

Okay I will! RAHHH!!

Raph sees a PIZZA VAN on it's side. He goes over and LIFTS

We gotta get you into therapy man!

They pile in. Raph looks to Leo.

Ya know, just then, for the first
          time in your life, you didn't sound
          lame! You actually sounded like a
          leader.

I do! Oh I do! Oh I sound like such
          a leader, holy crap that's so dope!

They DRIVE towards SUPER DUPER FLY!

THEY SPEED PAST A PILE of RUBBLE and we see APRIL emerge!

Dear lord this helmet was a good
          investment!

She looks up at the nearest JUMBO SCREEN and sees the
headlines about how the TURTLES are VILLAINS.

She sees the screen is attached to the ACTUAL NEWS BUILDING.
She RUNS TOWARDS IT.

April makes her way through the building as we see Superfly:
Mega Mutant wreaking havoc out the windows.

Ok, not great. Not great at all.
          No, very bad. Yeah.
We see an ANCHOR at the news desk, reporting.

If you're just joining us, an army
          of mutants that appears to be lead
          by four turtle men is attacking the
          city with a giant whale monster.

The ANCHOR runs away! The CAMERA GUYS look at each other,
when APRIL BURSTS in and heads for the desk.

Keep rolling!!!! I got the REAL
          story!!!

April PLOPS down behind the desk.

April O'Neil here and...

She looks at the LIGHTS and CAMERAS. HER HEART STARTS TO
BEAT. She starts to SWEAT! The camera guys POINT TO HER!
She's ON!!! The tension BUILDS AND BUILDS... until - April
CLEARS HER THROAT and looks DEAD IN THE CAMERA.

(reporting PERFECTLY)
          April O'Neil here reporting live
          with new and CONFIRMED information -
          A fly-monster is attacking the
          city, but the turtle teens, along
          with the rat, warthog, stingray,
          crocodile, bat, frog, lizard and
          cockroach lady are in fact fighting
          AGAINST the monster in an attempt
          to SAVE New York! The giant monster
          is bad, but the mutants you see
          here are in fact GOOD!

April PUKES EVERYWHERE!!!!!!

Sorry I really thought I got past
          that, that's a thing from my past.
          Anyway, as I was saying...

The VAN speeds through the streets towards Superfly: Mega
Mutant! Scumbug flies up holding Splinter.
Scumbug drops Splinter onto the van.

Whoah dad, you speak the same
          language as Scumbug?

We actually have a lot in common!
          I'm really attracted to her!!
Donnie! You should NOT be driving!

But since you are - go there!

He points a HUGE parking structure with SPIRAL RAMP going up
20 stories.

Superfly: Mega Mutant is SMASHING a building - oblivious!

I'm the king of New York!

They TURN ON TO THE RAMP AND SPEED IN CIRCLES!

Woo! That slide!

They FLY OFF THE RAMP and SOAR towards Superfly: Mega Mutant -
his BLOWHOLE in site -
-when HE GRABS THE PIZZA VAN!! He RIPS the roof off!

Gotcha!

He GRABS them in his CLAW! They DROP the vial and SPLINTER
GRABS it as he LEAPS through the air from the van - but
Superfly: Mega Mutant SWATS HIM - HE SOARS THROUGH THE AIR -
CRASHING in TIMES SQUARE!
Superfly: Mega Mutant looks to the turtles in his claw.

That's it! You're done. It's over.
          You are never gonna stop me! And
          humans are never gonna like you!
          Because HUMANS SUCK!

elements.name: b
elements.content: HE STARTS TO CRUSH THEM! THEM SCREAM IN AGONY!!!

These shells are hard! I'm about to
          snap you like a pistachio.

Their SHELLS BEGIN TO CRACK A BIT!

Look, I know I said your faces
          weren't the last thing I wanted to
          see before I died! But now that
          we're actually about to die...
          there's nothing I'd rather be
          looking at!

We see SPLINTER in a HEAP. He tries to get up but his LEG IS
MANGLED! He has the vial of OOZE, but it's CRACKED on the
ground beside him! He goes to GRAB it but CAN'T TOUCH IT!

HE SEES THE TURTLES getting CRUSHED by Superfly: Mega Mutant!

Damn these shells are hard!

Then - he sees a HUMAN APPROACHING! He RECOILS IN FEAR!!!

No! No!

But then - he sees - the human is EXTENDING HIS HAND TO HELP!

Hey, are you okay? Do you need
          help?

It's him! He's with the turtles!

HE LOOKS AT THE NEWS - APRIL is TELLING THE STORY!

Those turtles are not the bad guys!
          They're actually teenagers! And
          fighting against the giant monster!
          I have the whole story.

We'll go to a hospital or a
          veterinarian.

No no. I must get this to my boys!

A human puts the LEAKING VIAL in a THANK YOU plastic bag.
Hey the humans! They're helping us!

Oh no they AIN'T!!

Superfly: Mega Mutant flings a car at him!

There's a GAP in the road - the guy can't make it!

Genghis Frog appears!

Hop on! Let's go!

The guy GETS ON AND Genghis HOPS over the gap!

He's hopping until there's an EXPLOSION - the vial is KNOCKED
free and sails through the air - until a CABBY catches it!

Hey! I'm a cabbie from the Bronx!
          How bout that!

Get that to the monster!

The cabby SPEEDS towards the monster - until RUBBLE falls in
the road right in front of him! He's about to crash when
SCUMBUG AND WINGNUT BOTH appear and LIFT the CAB in to the
air!
I'm being helpful! Wow I'm strong!

Blagahghagh!

Superfly: Mega Mutant HURLS a statue at them.

Wingnut and Scumbug DROP the cab and Bebop and Rocksteady
catch it!!!

Gotcha!

They set it down and help out the woozy driver.

Hey human! Got it from here bro!

Mondo takes the bag and expertly skates through the debris
field.

Superfly: Mega Mutant hurls radio antennae at him like
javelins!

I'm gonna mess you up right here,
          right now!

More young New York skaters show up and they pass it back and
forth.

Dang Mondo, you slippery lizard!

They get to a sinkhole in the road flooding with water. Ray
Fillet grabs the vile and swims it across!

He tosses it to a construction worker who jumps on the hook
of a crane. The crane operator hoists him in the air.

I got it!
              (to Turtles)
          Hey! I heard you need this!

Another construction worker smacks Superfly: Mega Mutant in
the heel with a backhoe!

elements.name: b
elements.content: AHHHH! OW! MAN DAMN! STOP! THE

The turtles SEIZE the opportunity to WRIGGLE out of Superfly:
Mega Mutant's claw!

People and mutants attack Superfly: Mega Mutant from all
sides at once! They crash cars into his feet! Smack him with
cranes!

People TOSS everything they can out of their apartment
windows, raining debris down on Superfly: Mega Mutant.

Throw it over!

The construction worker tosses the turtles the vial.

He catches it.

Coming in hot!

He tosses it to Donnie who RUNS through a high-rise as
Superfly: Mega Mutant swings his claw at him.

Raph!

Donnie tosses it back to Raph.

Leo!

Superfly: Mega Mutant is too distracted to stop them!!

Got it!

LEO jumps in the air, vial in hand-

Leo DUNKS the vial into Superfly: Mega Mutant's blowhole.

The turtles land on Superfly: Mega Mutant in formation.

Wah!! Damn!! Oh, you think this the
          end of me?

Rays of blue light SHOOT OUT between the fish composing
Superfly: Mega Mutant's body!

He EXPLODES! The various animals composing him fall safely to
the ground, along with the turtles.

People see it's safe to come out and flood the streets.
EVERYONE is cheering for the turtles!

Firefighters! Cops! Skaters! Teens! Business people! Families
with kids!!

Sign my baby!

A nearby reporter covers the story.

(on screen)
          Again, we're reporting live with
          footage of the mutant hero turtles
          who saved New York...

The turtles look at each other. This is everything they ever
wanted.

In a story broken by April- wait,
          what's your name?

April grabs the microphone from the reporter.

April O'Neil. That's April O'
          apostrophe Neil, Not Puke Girl. And
          if you ever call me Puke Girl, bite
          me! Cus I did it! Yeah! Woo!

Bebop, Rocksteady and the other mutants emerge from the
rubble. They're all okay!

You know, it's hard to meet other
          mutants my age.

Scumbug GRABS Splinter and MAKES OUT WITH HIM!
Ray Fillet sings in the sewer.

Mondo Gecko is SKATEBOARDING in a pipe while Genghis films
it.

Can't wait to add that to my
          footy!!

Splinter and Scumbug hurry to pack the turtles' lunches.

Wingnut is going through Donnie's manga collection.

The entire Akira original set!
          Don't mind if I do!!

Bebop and Rocksteady move a couch.

I pictured the couch against the
          wall!

Hey that's not basic!

They start to WRESTLE. LEATHERHEAD puts out a bloomin' onion.

`Ey mates, Bloomin' Onion, coming
          right up.

Genghis EATS it with his tongue.

I can not believe it.... Your first
          day of school. Just remember, you
          call any time you want! If you get
          scared, there are sewers ALL over
          the city! Just hop into the sewer!
          You can come home anytime! And if
          anyone messes with you, call me! I
          will come kick their butts! Hoo-ha!
And she will eat what's left!

Yeah... don't worry. We're ready
          for this.

Trust us, you've prepared us for
          this.

Alright.
              (beat)
          I'm proud of you boys. I love you.

Love you too!
              (to Scumbug)
          And I love you too, sweetie!

Ugh./Dad!/That's gross!

Mikey climbs up the ladder after his brothers.

Now go show those humans how cool
          you are.

He drops his ORANGE FACE MASK which Splinter catches below.
The turtles approach the school on their first day.

The turtles enter the school. We see PROM IS BACK! Posters
around the hallway.

Kids look at the turtles - then CHEER!! They come around and
start to TALK TO THEM - welcoming them to the school.

Yo!/ It's the turtles!/I'm so glad
          you're here!

Guys! I'm so happy you made it, let
          me show you around!

They walk down the hallways, past April's locker. "Puke Girl"
has been replaced with "April O'Hero."

WE SEE CELL PHONE FOOTAGE of the turtles filming themselves
on their first day of school.

Hey! Hello! It's Donnie... and I
          have found my people! Haha!

WE SEE a group of kids hanging out on the steps with
computers, playing video games.

CELL PHONE FOOTAGE of RAPH and some JOCKS practicing
wrestling.

Haha! Fold him in half!

FOOTAGE of Mikey doing IMPROV with other kids to an EMPTY

(in Australian accent)
          G'day Mate! Welcome to my
          Australian shoe store!

No, but I do have the Australian
          version, Crikeys!

FOOTAGE of April and Leo working in the DARK ROOM...

(to camera)
          April O'Neil here... working on the
          NEXT big story for April Tonight!

(to Leo) Leo how many times-
          landscape! Landscape!

Oh, yep sorry my bad.

He turns the camera.

WHO IS TCRI!?! The shady black ops
          organization behind the mutants!
          Their offices, ABANDONED after the
          mutant attack. Gone without a
          trace!

Yeah we will.

HE PUTS THE PHONE DOWN. WE go to normal movie.

(beat)
          Uh... hey April... Now that Prom is
          back on... uh... do you maybe want
          to... uh... well...

I'd love to, Leo.
              (beat)
          You looked like you were gonna puke
          there.

CUT TO PROM! It's LOVELY AND WONDERFUL.

They're having a BLAST, hanging with humans, loving that life
baby!
Wait, this is as friends right?

Mikey dances, the others cheering him on.

WE PULL UP AND AWAY from them watching the movie. The camera
getting HIGHER AND HIGHER... WE REVEAL WE ARE SEEING
SURVEILLANCE FOOTAGE of the scene.

WE pull back to see CYNTHIA UTROM at NEW TCRI - WATCHING THE
TURTLES. A familiar looking FLY moves around in a container
next to her.

Well... it appears as though
           finding these creatures will be
           easier than I thought. CAPTURING
           them on the other hand... might
           prove difficult.

elements.content: OVERLOOKING THE CITY IS AN IMPOSING SILHOUETTE.
